ctx.x: James Thomas Whaley. And my mother was born in Richmond, Virginia and he was born in Fairfax County of West Virginia. I believe my father was an Indian because I went down there in 1902 and I saw this great big giant and my father said that was his father and he was a red man and he was a blacksmith and he could life a horse. That was in 1902 when we went down there.
